rationale: The target requires vehicle braking behaviour itself to be characterised, rather than merely mechanisms that influence braking. H-3 and SG-3 establish unexpected braking or stopping without an obstacle as the concern; FR-7 supports distinguishing this from braking justified by an actual obstacle. P preserves the stated operational context without incorporating detection, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” directly addresses whether unintended braking is prevented.
“Presence or absence of an actual obstacle requiring braking” relates braking to its justification, supported jointly by H-3 and FR-7.
The scope retains straight-ahead driving at 50 km/h on a less frequented urban road in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead.
“Brakes or stops unexpectedly” captures the hazardous vehicle behaviour itself, not an unsupported control-response or mechanism-timing requirement.
